on.subject: Join Staff AI workshop
on.text:
Hi Ann,

You’re invited to Staff AI workshop with Riverside.

Pre-call: Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. (America/Toronto)
Retreat: November 20 to 21, 2026

Open your room and tap Send me a sign-in code:
https://live.clearway.co/room/room-id?email=ann%40example.org

You can enter the 6-digit code on your phone or tap the confirm link in the email.

We’ll use AI in the room. Claude, an AI model from Anthropic, groups similar answers and helps us draft summaries. It never receives your name or email, everything it produces is marked as AI, and Clearway reviews every draft before your team sees it. You can read more when you sign in.
https://live.clearway.co/how-we-use-ai

Before we meet
Before we meet: open from Nov 16, 2026, 10:00 a.m. until Nov 18, 2026, 10:00 a.m. (America/Toronto)
https://live.clearway.co/room/room-id?email=ann%40example.org&step=s1

How the room decides
We decide together.

We look forward to being with you.
Clearway
